statements.text: Carbohydrates and fats are energy-giving food components.
Only carbohydrates are energy-giving; fats are foods to avoid.
Proteins and fats are the energy-giving components here.

stem:
Bilal packs boiled potatoes and a little mustard oil for a long trek. He knows foods can be energy-giving, body-building, or protective.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Carbohydrates and fats provide energy for activities, so they are energy-giving. Fats are not simply foods to avoid, and proteins are not the energy-giving pair here.
